# Bundled Tesseract `tessdata_fast`

These archives are the offline Thai and English `4.0.0_fast` language files
used by the M1.3A payment analyzer. They are intentionally committed beside
the application so request-time OCR never downloads a model.

Source:

- https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast/tha.traineddata.gz
- https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast/eng.traineddata.gz

SHA-256:

- `tha.traineddata.gz`: `95dd901cd44071b20f58c940d8e2713d20e85282ff1ea0460a134d9ca357f700`
- `eng.traineddata.gz`: `18c1ac52b75e35d44735fb6c2a60acfaf23033524653200738e98f0243edb75b`

The files are distributed under the upstream Tesseract language-data license.
